dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent O-shaped rings with high-contrast serrated perimeters; darker exterior edges transition sharply to lighter grey interiors, specifically on the mid-posterior dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, clustered primarily on the anterior-dorsal region near the head and flipper junction.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary cluster of three large annuli on the upper mid-body forms a scalene triangle, while a secondary chain of four smaller blobs follows a curvilinear path along the lateral-ventral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct high-intensity collar-like band of concentrated small rings follows the skin fold at the base of the neck.
